name: drawer
title: UI Drawer
desc: A bottom panel whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the backdrop dim and bottom-edge slide-up are keyframed presets, with a drag handle and a primary action. Self-contained — pair it with the Button as a trigger (see the example).

name: drift
title: Drift
desc: A slow linear camera push-in wrapper that scales its scene from 1 to 1+grow across the sequence so no frame is ever static.

name: drop-timer
title: Drop Timer
desc: A countdown to a drop ends in a huge gradient 'LIVE NOW' with a URL and logo.

name: drop-upload
title: Drop Upload
desc: A file card drops in and fills an upload bar until a check confirms it.

name: dropdown-menu
title: UI Dropdown Menu
desc: A dropdown menu whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline; the trigger reuses the Button primitive and the reveal panel composes DropdownMenuItem rows. The panel fade, scale, lift, and chevron are keyframed presets.

name: dropdown-menu-item
title: UI Dropdown Menu Item
desc: A dropdown menu action row whose idle/hover/press state is a pure function of the timeline; the row background and label color are keyframed presets. Composed inside the DropdownMenu panel.

name: duet-split
title: Duet Split
desc: A split screen contrasts a slow grey side with a crisp gradient side: '1 day' versus '$0'.

name: dumbbell-shift
title: Dumbbell Shift
desc: Dumbbell rows slide their before and after dots apart, with a +16 summary.

name: duotone-beat
title: Duotone Beat
desc: A two-ink halftone portrait swaps its ink pair on every beat, with a punch-in on the downbeat and a bar indicator.

name: dynamic-letter
title: Dynamic Letter
desc: The wordmark appears while one letter morphs through shapes before settling as the final O.

name: echo-stack
title: Echo Stack
desc: A word focuses in at the center while outline copies of it unfold above and below and keep drifting, like the one clear line on a spinning drum.

name: ecosystem-constellation
title: Ecosystem Constellation
desc: A central logo orbited by integration satellites with pulsing data lines.

name: edge-fit
title: Edge Fit
desc: A single huge cream word, 'recaps', fills the frame edge to edge with a caption and logo.

name: edit-ripple
title: Edit Ripple
desc: "Change your mind, render it again." with the second line indented and ripple-coloured.

name: ellipsis-resolve
title: Ellipsis Resolve
desc: Three dots pulse and resolve into a gradient word and a closing period.

name: embargo-lift
title: Embargo Lift
desc: "remocn is free, open source and out today" in condensed type with a green accent.

name: ember-burn
title: Ember Burn
desc: The outgoing frame catches fire where it is brightest, boils in the heat, chars at the rim, and blows away as sparks carrying its own colour.

name: embossed-mark
title: Embossed Mark
desc: The R mark and wordmark are debossed into a brushed grey surface as it lights up.

name: enhance-count
title: Enhance Count
desc: A blurred line sharpens in place, 'Draft it fast. Finish it sharp.', the last word accented.

name: escalate-cards
title: Escalate Cards
desc: Cards flash one word each, accelerating until the last word fills the frame over a date.

name: exactly
title: Exactly
desc: A yellow "Exactly." lands first, then "It's just code." completes the answer.

name: exploded-view
title: Exploded View
desc: An isometric stack of slabs springs apart with leader lines and labels, holds, then clicks back together.

name: extrude-pop
title: Extrude Pop
desc: A flat word pops up out of the plane on a solid colored 3D body, no camera involved.

name: factor-out
title: Factor Out
desc: Three short imperatives stack above a big blue "in your editor.".

name: fade-through
title: Fade Through
desc: A Material-style content transition: old fades out, new fades in with a soft delay.

name: feather-settle
title: Feather Settle
desc: "Your launch, landing softly." settles in as if falling like a feather on a taupe ground.

name: feature-chips-flow
title: Feature Chips Flow
desc: Rows of feature pills stream by, then snap into a cluster around the logo.

name: feature-flag-rollout
title: Feature Flag Rollout
desc: A feature flag rolls out to 100% while error rate guardrails stay green.

name: feature-headline
title: Feature Headline
desc: A tag pill opens from the left, then a headline rises: 'Captions that move with every word.'.

name: feature-trio
title: Feature Trio
desc: Three feature words, 'Fast. Composable. Open source.', rise from masks with progress ticks and notes.

name: field
title: UI Field
desc: A static layout family for composing labeled form controls, modeled on shadcn's Field: FieldGroup ▸ Field ▸ FieldLabel / FieldControl / FieldDescription. Reads no frame and holds no state — colors come from the resolved theme. FieldControl is a relative fixed-height slot for the absolute remocn-ui controls (Input, Button).

name: figure-reels
title: Figure Reels
desc: A $400M figure announces itself between two scrolling image reels.

name: figure-to-label
title: Figure to Label
desc: A $6.4B figure resolves into its label "valuation" under the Remocn mark.

name: file-dropzone
title: File Dropzone
desc: Files drop into a knowledge base list and an upload toast confirms.

name: filler-cut
title: Filler Cut
desc: A transcript has its filler words cut, leaving a clean line, 'Ship your launch video today.'.

name: fine-print-up
title: Fine Print Up
desc: "No account and no watermark. Ever." in a big serif with tiny fine print at the bottom.

name: first-light
title: First Light
desc: The remocn wordmark is swept by a band of light along a baseline, with a tagline below.

name: flank-roll-swap
title: Flank Roll Swap
desc: "Out now ... on remocn.dev" rolls its flanking words around a sunset image in the middle.

name: flash-count
title: Flash Count
desc: A counter lands on 3,600 with a camera-flash pop, an exposure eyebrow in the corner.

name: flash-sweep
title: Flash Sweep
desc: A tilted band of light sweeps across the frame and swaps one shot for the next.

name: flick-swap
title: Flick Swap
desc: A headline flicks into place with a gradient second line, 'Grounds that never sit still.'.

name: flip-sting
title: Flip Sting
desc: The logo flips into place with a small tracked line settling under it.

name: flock-form
title: Flock Form
desc: A flock of birds flies in, forms an arrow, then settles into the R mark.

name: flood-sting
title: Flood Sting
desc: A flood of blue fills the frame and the Remocn wordmark lands between two dots.

name: flow-arrow
title: Flow Arrow
desc: A dotted gradient arrow zigzags upward beside a 3x growth stat.

name: flow-builder
title: Flow Builder
desc: A workflow canvas connects nodes, branches by plan and publishes with a toast.

name: flow-field
title: Flow Field
desc: Hundreds of particles ride a seeded noise field, leaving silky fading trails in a seamless loop.

name: fluted-glass
title: Fluted Glass
desc: Fluted glass refracts a gradient orb and its headline, clearing as it comes into focus.

name: focus-blur-resolve
title: Focus Blur Resolve
desc: A premium focus pull from heavy blur to crisp text, then a soft blur-out exit.

name: focus-front-swap
title: Focus Front Swap
desc: A headline pulls focus front-to-back to swap its last word to "tonight".

name: focus-pan-text
title: Focus Pan Text
desc: Blurred earlier lines stack above while focus pans down to "You're ready to launch." and a toolbar.

name: focus-pull
title: Focus Pull
desc: A rack-focus transition that defocuses the outgoing scene into a bright blur and resolves the next one into focus.

name: fog-rise
title: Fog Rise
desc: Display text resolves out of fog: characters sharpen from heavy blur center-out with vertical streaks dissolving above them, as if rising along the z-axis.

name: fomo-limit-orders
title: Order Flow
desc: An independent 18-second trading-interface demo with fictional market data, graphite and amber styling, an original stepped mark, and editable camera choreography.

name: font-cycle
title: Font Cycle
desc: One word cycles through several typefaces and settles in its final face.

name: fourier-sum
title: Fourier Sum
desc: Sine harmonics add up one by one into a square wave under a serif caption.

name: fraction-split
title: Fraction Split
desc: A row of eight boxes shows one filled, matching the headline "1/8 the time".

name: free-as-in
title: Free As in
desc: A big "Free" is glossed line by line: as in beer, speech, no seats, yours.

name: frosted-clear
title: Frosted Clear
desc: A frosted glass card clears to show a large 10x stat with a kicker.

name: fuchidori-count
title: Fuchidori Count
desc: A sticker-style counter whose digits gain stacked red outline borders, landing on 4,096.

name: full-bleed-type
title: Full Bleed Type
desc: Huge condensed caps words slam in one at a time, the last lit by a sunrise gradient.

name: galton-stack
title: Galton Stack
desc: Dots fall through a Galton board into a bell curve, marked at 95%.

name: gear-shift
title: Gear Shift
desc: A big 42 shifts up through numbered gear steps on a teal panel with a caption.

name: ghost-complete
title: Ghost Complete
desc: Grey ghost suggestions autocomplete a sentence, each accepted with a Tab keypress.

name: giant-mark-backdrop
title: Giant Mark Backdrop
desc: A huge wordmark scrolls behind a floating prompt card on a warm paper ground.

name: github-sponsors
title: GitHub Sponsors
desc: Self-drawing Sponsors heart that docks to a header, every sponsor avatar blur-staggering into a grid, then a thank-you headline and a CTA. Single seek-safe timeline, 270 frames at 30fps.

name: github-stars
title: GitHub Stars
desc: Inertial fly-through of a repo's stargazers with a synced count-up odometer that locks on the total. Horizontal 16:9 or vertical 9:16.

name: glass-capsule
title: Glass Capsule
desc: A glass capsule slides over the focus word of a two-line headline, magnifying it in italic.

name: glass-code-block
title: Glass Code Block
desc: A premium frosted-glass code editor window with a regex tokenizer and line-by-line stagger reveal.

name: glass-code-walk
title: Glass Code Walk
desc: A camera that scans a glass code block top to bottom as it types, then pulls back to a centered hold.

name: glass-lens
title: Glass Lens
desc: A glass lens drop magnifies a headline word, glides to a clip and flattens into a CTA pill.

name: glitch-cut
title: Glitch Cut
desc: A broadcast-glitch hard cut: the frame tears into displaced slices with channel split and corrupted blocks, and the incoming scene takes over slice by slice at the peak.

name: glow-born-card
title: Glow Born Card
desc: A glow condenses into an "Import from repository" dialog beside split headline text.

name: glyph-anatomy
title: Glyph Anatomy
desc: A word builds as in a font editor, with metric guides, anchors along each contour and Bézier handles that pull straight segments into curves before the glyphs fill.

name: glyph-block-decode
title: Glyph Block Decode
desc: Blocky glyphs decode into "Remocn Studio" with its URL underlined beneath.

name: glyph-matrix
title: Glyph Matrix
desc: A round LED dot matrix counts 3-2-1, then its dots hop into the R mark and the logo.

name: glyph-relay
title: Glyph Relay
desc: "Building a product" hands off between lines until a giant question mark resolves into "Launching it?".

name: gooey-morph
title: Gooey Morph
desc: Bars fly in Tetris-style, land as a row, and melt into a word through a gooey blur-and-threshold morph.

name: got-em
title: Got Em
desc: A suspense line resolves into an exploded 'GOT 'EM' over a gradient sunburst.

name: gradient-scale-cut-text
title: Gradient Scale Cut Text
desc: An oversized gradient reveal snaps to a separate compact blurred line that settles left while the reveal continues.

name: grain-dissolve
title: Grain Dissolve
desc: A grain-gradient shader transition that disintegrates the outgoing scene into soft grainy shapes and condenses the next scene out of the noise.

name: graph-relayout
title: Graph Relayout
desc: A node graph re-lays itself out to fan one prompt into voice, music and every aspect ratio.

name: gravity-grid
title: Gravity Grid
desc: A grid bends into a gravity well and the logo lands at its bottom.

name: gravity-pile
title: Gravity Pile
desc: Seeded circles, squares and triangles rain down, bounce off the floor and each other, and settle into a heap.

name: grid-cell
title: Grid Cell
desc: A grid cell lights up and 'Introducing remocn 2.0' is typed into it with a mono label.

name: grid-montage
title: Grid Montage
desc: One shot splits into a 2x2 then a 3x3 montage, cutting on the beat.

name: grid-snap-poster
title: Grid Snap Poster
desc: A giant gradient 3.0 snaps onto a grid poster with a headline and caption.

name: grid-to-app
title: Grid to App
desc: A product grid expands into a store admin app with sidebar and product catalogue.

name: grid-wave
title: Grid Wave
desc: A wave travels across the frame raising the picture into a grid of solid blocks with lit tops and shaded sides, which set back down carrying the next scene.

name: growth-line
title: Growth Line
desc: An exponential growth curve draws through milestones to a 100k endpoint.

name: gsh
title: Gradient Ground
desc: Animated gradient grounds for Remotion: the free gradients.sh engine (WebGL2) with 39 presets, driven by the current frame.

name: hairline-open
title: Hairline Open
desc: A hairline of light opens like a slit onto the next serif statement.

name: half-built
title: Half Built
desc: A sentence where unfinished verbs are outlined and fill in, tagged Summer and Later.

name: halftone-cut
title: Halftone Cut
desc: A halftone dot pattern cuts one headline into the next on a warm gradient.

name: halftone-print
title: Halftone Print
desc: Print a scene onto paper: each colour separates onto its own rotated screen of dots sized by the ink under them, slightly out of register the way a real press runs.

name: hand-count
title: Hand Count
desc: A number that counts up in stop-motion poses, rewritten by hand at every pose and freezing still once it lands.

name: handwrite
title: Handwrite
desc: Handwritten text laid down letter by letter on a quantized stop-motion clock, each glyph keeping its own slant and baseline wobble.

name: hatch-shade
title: Hatch Shade
desc: A serif number is shaded in with engraving-style hatch lines on a copper plate.

name: headline-to-line
title: Headline to Line
desc: A headline settles and its phrase collapses toward a single line over a glowing horizon.

name: heat-drain-reveal
title: Heat Drain Reveal
desc: A dark launch calendar cools from heat into a dithered glow and highlights the launch day.
